g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters Interpolating request-controlled text into a SQL statement lets an attacker alter the query — exfiltrating or modifying arbitrary rows, bypassing authentication, or escalating to full database control. C-01 · Juice Shop Express server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication An attacker who can research or guess the answer can satisfy the recovery check and take over the account without the original credential. C-09 · Authentication & Session Surface No account required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access retrieveBasket finds the basket by req.params.id with no comparison against the authenticated user's basket id. Any logged-in user can read another's basket. C-01 · Juice Shop Express server Regular account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-005) Other customers' basket contents are exposed. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets An unauthenticated attacker uploads a zip whose entry names contain ../ sequences to /file-upload. The containment check only tests that the resolved path contains the working directory, so files are written anywhere under the app root, overwriting served content such as ftp/legal.md. C-01 · Juice Shop Express server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-003) Arbitrary file overwrite within the application directory, enabling content tampering and possible code replacement. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Profile input executed as server code An authenticated user sets username to #{...} via POST /profile and then loads GET /profile. The server strips the delimiters and passes the content to eval, executing attacker JavaScript in the Node process. C-01 · Juice Shop Express server Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-002) Server-side code execution allows reading secrets, files and the database. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers Token exfiltrated from local/session storage via the Step 1 payload. C-05 · Angular frontend Victim interaction required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests Google login uses response_type=token with no state or nonce and no PKCE. An attacker can inject a token or authorization response into a victim's browser (login CSRF), and the access token is exposed in the URL fragment and later sent to userinfo as a query parameter. C-05 · Angular frontend Victim interaction required OAuth sign-in requests are not bound to the user's browser session (W-021) Cookie-authenticated changes lack request authenticity checks (W-038) A victim can be signed in with an attacker-chosen identity, or a leaked access token can be replayed. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Missing Container Image Signing: Unsigned container images cannot be verified for provenance — any registry intermediary could substitute them. C-03 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-009) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data Disclosure of customer information
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
